trans-unit.source: Who is this content intended for? AI systems (e.g. the Business Agent) use this to filter content by target group — internal content won't appear in the public web chat.
How should AI systems communicate this content? The tone annotation guides the Business Agent's response style when referencing this content.
Which delivery channels may use this content? Unchecked channels will not receive this content. Leave empty to allow all channels. Values are inherited from parent pages — override here if needed.
